statement: The H-1B annual numerical cap does not apply to a beneficiary who is employed, or has received an offer of employment, at an institution of higher education or a related or affiliated nonprofit entity, or at a nonprofit research organization or a governmental research organization; separately, beneficiaries who have earned a master's or higher degree from a US institution of higher education are exempt until 20,000 such exemptions are used in the fiscal year (INA § 214(g)(5), 8 U.S.C. § 1184(g)(5)).
caveat: Whether an employer is 'related or affiliated' to a university or counts as a 'research organization' is adjudicated case-by-case under the definitions at 8 CFR 214.2(h)(8)(iii)(F); a typical startup is cap-subject and goes through the electronic registration selection. Immigration decisions need counsel.
